mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will raise borrowing costs and pressure equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply chain and reduced economic activity that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following a decline in industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following a decline in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines by > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer prices signals rising inflationary pressures that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPI rises by > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate combined with a sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a monetary policy response to a weakening economy that will support equity valuations and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines > 0.5pp and UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by > 0.5pp and UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp.
